SSH remains available whether the extension is absent, blocked, or incompatible. Terminal Spike performs SSH authentication and the trusted mosh-server bootstrap. Saved passwords, private keys, and passphrases are never sent to the extension.

The separately installed extension is GPL-3.0-or-later software and contains the pinned Mosh transport. Complete corresponding source, checksums, modification patches, notices, and reproducible build scripts are supplied with its source distribution. No GPL or native Mosh implementation is included in the main app.
Mosh is a registered trademark. This Mosh-compatible extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mosh project.
Mosh requires the separate companion APK built from this project’s mosh-extension module. Use the version distributed with this app; Android also requires it to have the matching signing identity.

For a local debug build, run ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :mosh-extension:assembleDebug, then use adb install -r for both app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk and mosh-extension/build/outputs/apk/debug/mosh-extension-debug.apk.
For a distributed build, obtain the matching companion APK and its complete corresponding source from the same trusted source distribution as this app.
Retry only asks Android to check again after the companion APK is installed. It does not download or install software.
